arguments.content: import urllib.request, urllib.parse, re, html, json, os, sys, time UA = {'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0 Safari/537.36', 'Accept-Language': 'en-US,en;q=0.9'} def fetch(u): req = urllib.request.Request(u, headers=UA) with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=25) as r: return r.status, r.read().decode('utf-8', 'ignore') def clean(t): t = re.sub(r'', ' ', t, flags=re.S | re.I) t = re.sub(r'', ' ', t, flags=re.S | re.I) t = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', ' ', t) t = html.unescape(t) return re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', t).strip() queries = [ '"Duan Yihe" NUS', '"Duan Yihe" "Electrical and Computer Engineering"', '"Duan Yihe" Singapore', '"Yihe Duan" NUS', '"Duan Yihe" thesis', '"Duan Yihe" paper', '"Yihe Duan" "National University of Singapore"', ] engines = { 'bing': 'https://www.bing.com/search?q={}&count=30', 'google': 'https://www.google.com/search?q={}&num=20', 'ddg': 'https://html.duckduckgo.com/html/?q={}', } out = [] for q in queries: for name, tmpl in engines.items(): url = tmpl.format(urllib.parse.quote(q)) try: status, body = fetch(url) except Exception as e: out.append({'q': q, 'engine': name, 'error': repr(e)}) continue rec = {'q': q, 'engine': name, 'status': status, 'len': len(body)} text = clean(body) rec['text_head'] = text[:1500] links = [] # generic anchors for m in re.finditer(r']+href="([^"]+)"[^>]*>(.*?)', body, flags=re.S | re.I): href = html.unescape(m.group(1)) label = clean(m.group(2)) if not label or len(label) < 3: continue if href.startswith('/'): base = {'bing': 'https://www.bing.com', 'google': 'https://www.google.com', 'ddg': 'https://duckduckgo.com'}[name] href = base + href if href.startswith('http'): links.append({'href': href, 'label': label[:200]}) rec['links'] = links[:80] out.append(rec) with open('results.json', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f: json.dump(out, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1) with open('results.txt', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f: for rec in out: f.write('=' * 90 + '\n') f.write('QUERY: %s | ENGINE: %s | STATUS: %s | LEN: %s\n' % (rec.get('q'), rec.get('engine'), rec.get('status'), rec.get('len'))) if rec.get('error'): f.write('ERROR: %s\n' % rec['error']) continue f.write('HEAD: %s\n' % rec.get('text_head', '')) f.write('-' * 40 + '\n') for l in rec.get('links', []): f.write('* %s\n %s\n' % (l['label'], l['href'])) print('done', len(out))
